rounds: I would rather live alone in a tiny flat than share a big one.
Owning a home is worth giving up holidays and nights out for in your twenties.
Parents should leave the family home to their children rather than sell it.
Living with your parents at thirty is nothing to be embarrassed about.
Your parents’ home should always keep a room waiting for you.
Berlin should build on every empty plot of land it can find.
I would happily move to a small town to afford a much bigger home.
Ten years from now, most people my age will still be renting.
